title: EndSARS solidarity gathering at Nigerian High Commission, Accra

occurrence.summary: Reports a gathering of Nigerians in Ghana against Nigerian SARS/police violence; some asked Ghana’s president, as ECOWAS chair, to press the Nigerian president. Whether this is a domestic Ghana state-policy target or primarily a foreign-government grievance needs review.
